requirement: Enqueue PCs and return them at the consuming stage
basis: The port test checks the synchronous current PC of an accepted entry and its successor PC when next_val is set.

requirement: Restore CFI identity and return-address history after redirect
basis: A predicted later call redirected to an earlier conditional branch must not retain call identity or advance the successor RAS index.

requirement: Restore the saved return-address stack entry on redirect
basis: The redirected packet has a nonzero saved return address. The port test observes the repair write enable, index and address before the resumed request can read the RAS.
The initialized retired packet must produce one meaningful update preserving CFI, target and history.
The architectural trace comparison and the finite public-port test check different outputs.
